approval.scope: freeze eligible membership and grouped partitions only

grouping.structural_guard_reason: conservative blocking of identical structural templates; may overgroup unrelated pages; not a complete near-duplicate detector

limitations: All-candidate quality diagnostics were observed before partitioning; this is a newly reserved internal holdout, not an externally blinded or prospective sample.
Source labels have not been independently adjudicated.
Domain/exact/structural blocking does not guarantee absence of near-template, campaign, hosting or temporal dependence.
Numerical component and balance tolerances are project engineering choices, not professor requirements or thresholds borrowed from literature.
The professor PDF could not be reopened in this turn; the archived repository requirements are used without claiming a fresh PDF verification.

partition.selection_objective: minimize absolute per-label sample-count error relative to global 15% targets; no model or feature scores
partition.single_execution_rule: immutable output; no seed search or rerun for model outcomes

predictor_policy.content_marker_sensitivity: development only; no wholesale keyword-based relabeling or exclusion
predictor_policy.query_and_path_shortcut_sensitivity: design and validate on development only, before final test evaluation; do not resample cohort

purpose: internal same-cohort modality comparison; not a prospective or deployment benchmark
